name: Question 12
problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 \\ -1 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrix $A$ above. Which of the following represents the corresponding bilinear form ${x}^{T}\,Ay$ in terms of the components of $x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]$ and $y=[\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}]?$
worked_solution:
**Method 1**

Each entry ${a}_{ij}$ of $A$ corresponds to the term ${a}_{ij}{x}_{i}{y}_{j}$ in the expression of the bilinear form:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{T}\,Ay & =(-2){x}_{1}{y}_{1}+1{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+(-1){x}_{2}{y}_{1}+3{x}_{2}{y}_{2} \\  & =-2{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+{x}_{1}{y}_{2}-{x}_{2}{y}_{1}+3{x}_{2}{y}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

**Method 2**

To write down a bilinear form in terms of vector components, we compute the following expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{T}\,Ay & =[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & {x}_{2}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 \\ -1 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & {x}_{2}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-2{y}_{1}+{y}_{2} \\ -{y}_{1}+3{y}_{2}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={x}_{1}(-2{y}_{1}+{y}_{2})+{x}_{2}(-{y}_{1}+3{y}_{2}) \\  & =-2{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+{x}_{1}{y}_{2}-{x}_{2}{y}_{1}+3{x}_{2}{y}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Question 12
?

A=[−21−13] Consider the matrix A above. Which of the following represents the corresponding bilinear form xTAy in terms of the components of x=[x1x2] and y=[y1y2]?

a
x1y1+x1y2−2x2y1+3x2y2
b
−2x1y1+x1y2−x2y1+3x2y2
c
2x1y1+x1y2−x2y1+2x2y2
d
−2x1y1−x1y2+x2y1+3x2y2
e
−x1y1+2x1y2−x2y1+3x2y2
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

Method 1

Each entry aij of A corresponds to the term aijxiyj in the expression of the bilinear form:

xTAy=(−2)x1y1+1x1y2+(−1)x2y1+3x2y2=−2x1y1+x1y2−x2y1+3x2y2

Method 2

To write down a bilinear form in terms of vector components, we compute the following expression:

xTAy=[x1x2][−21−13][y1y2]=[x1x2][−2y1+y2−y1+3y2]=x1(−2y1+y2)+x2(−y1+3y2)=−2x1y1+x1y2−x2y1+3x2y2
